items.title: Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Exploited to Backdoor Online Stores
items.summary: Attackers are actively exploiting a new unpatched vulnerability, named StyleSmuggler, in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution and installation of persistent backdoors. All current versions, including 2.4.9, are affected, and no official patch or CVE has been released by Adobe yet.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. The most severe, CVE-2026-71362, is a critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) that could lead to unauthenticated customer account takeover and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, CVE-2026-48413 is a high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: Included in APSB26-92, CVE-2026-48414 is a high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) that could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: APSB26-92 also addresses CVE-2026-48415, a high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: As part of APSB26-92, CVE-2026-48416 is a high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-71
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin (likely APSB26-71 due to publication date) resolves critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service, including CVE-2025-49554, CVE-2025-49555, CVE-2025-49556, and CVE-2025-49557.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-05
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read, covering multiple CVEs such as CVE-2026-21285, CVE-2026-21286, and CVE-2026-21310.
